fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
In this role, you'll own the logistics that keep our hiring machine running: interview scheduling, candidate communications, and tight coordination between recruiters and hiring managers. You'll also support day-to-day internal operations to keep things running smoothly behind the scenes. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love bringing order to chaos, and care deeply about getting the details right — this is for you.
This is a fully in-office role (5 days/week) at our San Mateo headquarters.
Responsibilities
Schedule and coordinate high volumes of interviews across multiple teams and time zones
Own candidate communications end-to-end, ensuring a seamless and timely experience throughout
Coordinate both virtual and onsite interviews, including logistics and panel scheduling
Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to keep pipelines moving
Maintain accurate candidate data and workflows in Greenhouse (ATS)
Track interview progress and proactively resolve scheduling conflicts before they become problems
Greet and host candidates on onsite interview days, making sure every visit feels polished and welcoming
Support HR administrative tasks including documentation and employee record-keeping
Provide operational support to the People team as needed
Preferred Qualifications
2–5 years of recruiting coordination or recruiting operations experience
Experience supporting high-volume hiring environments
Hands-on experience with Greenhouse ATS (or a comparable system)
Exceptional organizational skills — you can juggle competing priorities without dropping the ball
Clear, professional communicator in writing and in person
Relentlessly detail-oriented with strong follow-through
Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by a fast-paced startup environment
Able to work in-office 5 days/week in San Mateo
Nice to have
Experience supporting technical hiring (engineering, robotics, hardware, or AI)
Background in HR or People Operations

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Writer to translate complex robotic intelligence into clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation. In this role, you will be the connective tissue between our researchers, engineers, and the customers, operators, and developers who deploy our systems in the real world. You will own documentation across the full stack—from software architecture, APIs, and SDKs to deployment guides, operational procedures, and troubleshooting runbooks for robotic fleets in the field. Because our robots operate in diverse and challenging customer environments, your documentation must serve audiences ranging from ML researchers to field operators with no engineering background.
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for robotic intelligence software, including architecture overviews, APIs, SDKs, and codebases, serving both internal engineering teams and external developers and partners
Author clear deployment, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting documentation that enables operators and customers to run and manage fleets of robots in production environments
Collaborate closely with robotics researchers, ML engineers, software architects, and infrastructure teams to gather information, understand complex technical concepts, and accurately reflect product functionality and design
Own the documentation lifecycle end to end—from planning and drafting through review, publication, and ongoing updates—ensuring materials stay current, accurate, and easily accessible as products evolve rapidly
Establish and champion documentation best practices, style guidelines, and tooling; continually improve processes and content quality, and conduct peer reviews of documentation produced across teams
Maintain consistency in terminology, style, and tone across all documentation, tailoring content for audiences ranging from expert developers to non-technical field operators
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Technical Communication, English, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Experience as a technical writer producing documentation in a fast-paced, highly technical environment
Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and accurately to diverse audiences
Familiarity with software development concepts and comfort reading code (e.g., Python, C++, or similar)
Proven track record documenting complex software systems, including APIs, SDKs, and software architecture, and shipping high-quality documentation at scale
Experience creating deployment guides, operational procedures, maintenance manuals, or assembly documentation for hardware or robotic systems
Familiarity with modern documentation toolchains and workflows (e.g., Markdown, Git-based docs, static site generators) and version control best practices
Prior experience in robotics, AI, machine learning, or a related high-tech industry
Ability to understand the full flow of data and control—from a robot's sensors and models to an operator's screen—and reflect that understanding in documentation
Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Google Workspace for tracking, organizing, and publishing documentation
Base Salary Range
$100,000
—
$300,000 USD

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
We're looking for a Technical Recruiter to build out our presence in India, owning full-cycle recruiting for technical and engineering roles based there. You'll be part of our recruiting team based in California, while working independently to drive hiring needs in India. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build a hiring function in-region from the ground up.
Responsibilities
Own full-cycle recruiting for technical, engineering, and hardware/robotics roles based in India, from sourcing through offer close
Partner with India-based and global hiring managers to define role scope, calibrate on candidate bar, and build effective sourcing strategy
Build and manage strong candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, referrals, and market mapping specific to the Indian tech and robotics talent landscape
Drive an excellent candidate experience end-to-end, including timely communication and structured interview coordination across time zones
Maintain accurate pipeline data and reporting in Greenhouse (ATS)
Partner with the San Mateo talent team on compensation benchmarking, offer structuring, and closing strategy for India-based hires
Provide market intelligence on Indian tech/robotics hiring trends, compensation norms, and competitor talent moves
Preferred Qualifications
4-5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong track record of closing technical talent
A technical background or demonstrated fluency recruiting for engineering, robotics, hardware, or deep tech roles
Experience recruiting in the Indian tech ecosystem, with an existing network of engineering/robotics talent
Comfort working independently and asynchronously as part of a distributed, US-managed team
Strong command of Greenhouse or comparable ATS platforms
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Background in HR or People Operations

fields.duties:
Company Overview
At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
Position Overview
The Senior Accountant will be the primary accounting resource for Skild AI's US and international operations, working hands-on across accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, collections, payroll, and general ledger. This is an operational, individual-contributor role for someone equally comfortable processing an AP invoice and closing the books at month-end. You'll partner closely with the US-based Controller and Finance leadership to ensure accurate, timely financial reporting, and you'll take ownership working independently across time zones.
Responsibilities
Process vendor invoices end-to-end (receipt, coding, approval, payment) and manage weekly payment runs, vendor records, and statement reconciliations
Code all AP transactions to the correct cost center and GL account in Rillet and Rootstock ERP
Generate and issue customer invoices, apply cash receipts, and maintain the AR subledger in QuickBooks, reconciling AR aging weekly
Coordinate with the US Controller on revenue recognition treatment for customer contracts under ASC 606
Own collections end-to-end: correspondence, activity tracking, escalations, and monitoring DSO trends for the Controller
Own the full-cycle general ledger for the India subsidiary, including journal entries (accruals, prepayments, depreciation, intercompany) and monthly balance sheet reconciliations
Lead month-end and quarter-end close for the India entity, delivering accurate financials and variance analysis within the close calendar
Process and reconcile monthly payroll for India-based employees in QuickBooks, including statutory deductions (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) and coordination with HR on headcount changes
Maintain audit-ready documentation under US GAAP and support external auditors during the annual audit
Assist with sales and use, property, and income taxes alongside outside tax advisors, and ensure intercompany transactions are properly documented and reconciled monthly
Serve as the primary Rillet and Rootstock user across entities, maintaining chart of accounts and vendor/customer masters, and drive process improvements and system migrations as the finance stack evolves
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Accounting
5-8 years of hands-on accounting experience, with at least 2-3 years in a similar full-cycle role
Proficiency in QuickBooks (Online), with demonstrated practical, day-to-day usage
Strong working knowledge of US GAAP, particularly revenue recognition (ASC 606), accrual accounting, and financial statement preparation
Proven experience personally processing AP, AR, collections, payroll entries, and GL journal entries — not just in a supervisory capacity
Experience with full-cycle month-end and year-end close processes
High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, reconciliation tools)
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with US-based leadership across time zones
High attention to detail and personal accountability for accuracy
CPA, CPA qualification, or in progress a plus
Experience with intercompany accounting and multi-entity consolidations a plus
Exposure to ERP migration or implementation projects a plus
Experience in the technology or SaaS industry a plus
Base Salary Range
$120,000
—
$200,000 USD
